name: Airech

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero, foster son of Amairgin
steered the ship of the mysterious Donn
may be the steersman of the death barge

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Airech was an Irish hero and the foster son of Amairgin, the great bard of the Milesians. He plays a small part in Irish mythology. He steered the ship of the mysterious Donn. Because Donn is sometimes read as a ruler of death, Airech may be the steersman of the death barge.

okr.objective: Record Airech, the foster son of Amairgin who steered Donn's ship.
key_results: Show his part as steersman and his link to the figure of Donn.
